page_title: UDI 1-2 MON | Udinese v Monza 11/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' The referee demonstrates he won't tolerate this behaviour. Pedro Pereira (Monza) is given a yellow card.
90+3' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
90+3' It's like he was asking for a caution. Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) receives a yellow card.
90+1' Keita Balde (Monza) gets booked for the first time in this match.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' 1 - 2 Keita Balde (Monza) scores a goal! He latched on to a precise cross inside the box and beat the keeper with a shot to the middle of the goal.
87' A lofted cross finds an unmarked Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese), who leaps high and powers a header at goal. However, his header goes miles away of the left post. Poor effort.
87' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.

86' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
84' The substitution is prepared. Andrea Petagna (Monza) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gianluca Caprari.
84' Substitution. Patrick Ciurria (Monza) on for Georgios Kyriakopoulos.
83' Gianluca Caprari (Monza) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
80' What a miss! The corner finds Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) unmarked in the box with the goal at his mercy, but somehow he mistimes his header and sends it just over the bar.
80' The ball is out of play and Udinese manage to earn a corner.
80' Sandi Lovric (Udinese) shoots from the free kick towards the goal, but mishits the shot as it goes high over the bar. High, wide and not at all pretty!
79' Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle after Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Udinese are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
78' Alessandro Nesta has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stefano Sensi (Monza) replacing Alessandro Bianco.
75' 1 - 1 Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) struck from medium range. He smashed the ball inside the left post. What a hit! Pure magic.
75' Here is a change. Arthur Atta is going off and Kosta Runjaic gives the last tactical orders to Simone Pafundi (Udinese).
70' Keinan Davis will be replaced by Iker Bravo (Udinese).
68' Arthur Atta (Udinese) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
65' Alessandro Nesta has decided to substitute Gaetano Castrovilli and he is replaced by Kevin Zeroli (Monza).
65' Alessandro Nesta decides to make a substitution. Omari Forson will be replaced by Keita Balde (Monza).
63' Substitution. Jurgen Ekkelenkamp (Udinese) replaces Martin Payero.
62' The foul by Gianluca Caprari (Monza) was seen by Valerio Crezzini who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
60' The corner from Martin Payero (Udinese) is intercepted by the defence.
59' Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese) outjumps the defence to meet a whipped in cross. It's a fine looking effort towards the middle of the goal, but Semuel Pizzignacco reacts well to deny him.
57' Rui Modesto (Udinese) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
55' Martin Payero (Udinese) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
54' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Valerio Crezzini to decide it wasn’t handball. The relieved Monza players can finally celebrate.
53' The Monza players halt their celebrations as referee Valerio Crezzini makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.
52' 0 - 1 Gianluca Caprari (Monza) takes an advantage of chaos in the goalmouth and easily scores from a rebound.
52' Samuele Birindelli (Monza) shows his willingness to get forward and blasts a shot towards goal. Unfortunately for him, the shot isn't precise enough and hits the left post!
50' Arthur Atta (Udinese) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Oier Zarraga is replaced by Lorenzo Lucca (Udinese).
46' Kosta Runjaic has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Sandi Lovric (Udinese) comes on the pitch for Jaka Bijol.
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+1' Valerio Crezzini blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
43' Omari Forson (Monza) goes for goal, but his effort isn't precise at all and it flies yards wide of the right post.
42' Martin Payero (Udinese) has an effort from the edge of the area, but he skies the ball over the top.
39' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender.
38' Martin Payero (Udinese) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
34' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is caught offside!
29' Keinan Davis (Udinese) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Semuel Pizzignacco.
27' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

27' Nice individual effort by Oumar Solet (Udinese). He gets all the way through to the keeper and hits a low drive to the bottom left corner, but Semuel Pizzignacco does a good job to anticipate the direction of the ball and keeps it out.
25' A cross from Jesper Karlstrom (Udinese) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
23' Oier Zarraga (Udinese) misses the target from a promising position, sending the ball well wide of the left post.
19' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) controls the ball after receiving a cross, but he slices his shot well wide of the right post.
18' Hassane Kamara (Udinese) fails to produce a decent cross from the corner kick. The ball goes well out of play.

18' Arthur Atta (Udinese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The ball goes out of play. Udinese are awarded a corner kick.
15' Martin Payero (Udinese) got on the ball on the edge of the box and blazed a first-time shot well over the bar.
14' Martin Payero (Udinese) attempts to curl the ball over the wall from the free kick, but one of the defenders deflects it away from danger.
13' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Monza) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Valerio Crezzini had an easy-decision to make.
12' Keinan Davis (Udinese) is flagged for offside.
7' Andrea Carboni (Monza) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
6' Udinese fail to score from a corner as Semuel Pizzignacco (Monza) leaps to collect the ball.
5' Arthur Atta (Udinese) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play. Udinese will have a chance to score from a corner.
2' The Udinese players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Monza will kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Valerio Crezzini.
Show lineups We now know the starting lineups. You can find them in the match details of this match.
